item.title: 9 Calvin and Hobbes Comics from the 1990s that Prove Bill Watterson is a Genius
item.description: Calvin and Hobbes creator Bill Watterson is a genius . Over the course of ten years spanning more than 3,000 comic strips , he developed two truly irresistible characters that are still beloved by millions. There was a lot behind the success of Calvin and Hobbes , but I think part of the reason why Watterson is still so widely respected is that he was an incredibly versatile artist who managed to do a lot of different things in an artform that can sometimes be limiting.

item.title: Pokémon Go Pawniard Community Day event guide
item.description: Pokémon Go is having a Pawniard Community Day event on Saturday, Nov. 21 from 2-5 p.m. in your local time. This event is indeed running alongside the "Dynamax Trails" event , and it begins right when Eternatus' stint in the morning ends.

item.title: The Witcher 4 Gets Official Update on Physical Release
item.description: CD Projekt has confirmed that a physical version of The Witcher 4 will be released, even though the RPG is slated to launch after Sony Interactive Entertainment plans to stops producing physical games for PlayStation 5. Whether The Witcher 4 will be released on a physical disc is another matter entirely.

item.title: Everything We Know About GTA 7
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 has only just been released, so it might seem a bit early to start thinking about Grand Theft Auto 7 . I swear I’m not just writing an “Everything we know about GTA 7” article just so I can stuff a post with the “Everything we know about GTA 7” keyword and have Polygon own “Everything we know about GTA 7” search queries. That would be quite a gambit.

item.title: 8 Near-Perfect Fantasy Miniseries That Hook You in the First Episode
item.description: Fantasy television has given us some of the most imaginative stories ever told, transporting viewers to magical kingdoms, mysterious alternate realities, and worlds filled with creatures that shouldn't exist. Shows like Game of Thrones and Rings of Power dominate the conversation, pushing some of the genre's best storytelling to the forefront, but there’s something to be said of the smaller productions and shorter stories.

item.title: 'Steps' Ending Explained: Director Reveals the True Meaning Behind Cinderella Adaptation
item.description: Netflix’s newest animated sensation, directed by Alyce Tzue ( Soar ) and John Ripa ( Raya and the Last Dragon ), dares to ask: what if Cinderella’s ugly stepsisters weren’t so ugly and bad after all, but were instead besieged by a Western world that reacted to their East Asian heritage with distrust and unease?

item.title: Who is Johannes Zuch supposed to be in GTA 6?
item.description: Everyone is a target in Grand Theft Auto 6 . Even Jonathan Blow, the puzzle game designer known for The Witness and Order of the Sinking Star , isn’t safe.

item.description: Happy weekend! The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping is out in theaters, seemingly putting an end to one of the biggest franchises in recent years. It’s pretty good.

item.title: GTA 6 Players Are Officially Spending an ‘Absolutely Bonkers’ Amount of Time with the Game
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 players weren't kidding about wanting to spend the game's entire launch day in Leonida. Much hullabaloo was made about people requesting time off from work or faking sick to spend the entire day playing GTA 6 , and plenty of companies tried to capitalize on that conversation with marketing stunts .
